description: Everything both stores ask for, as one set of answers, the same as the person's Store details wizard on ploa.dev: the languages (each with its App Store and Google Play code), the text per language, the links and contact, category, age rating answers (with every question and its allowed answers), price and countries, App Review's contact and demo account, release, and privacy. Plus problems: what each store would refuse now (FIX) and what's likely a mistake (check), each with the step and language it's in, and what's left for the person to enter by hand in a store's console, with links. Start here; then ploa_details_save, ploa_privacy_save, and ploa_details_send.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask the stores again instead of the copy from the last two minutes.

step.description: Only one step's answers; all when left out.

name: ploa_details_get
title: Read the store details
